limitations: Population density and Overture building density are context covariates, not observed map completeness or target proxies.
The fixed support scales and positive adjustment direction are qualitative assumptions; without labels or an authorized scored evaluation their accuracy is unknown.
Centroid-radius neighborhoods are a deterministic spatial context, not an adjacency or service-area model.
The eastern-WA rows are template-only, have no features, and receive zero formatting values without any target claim.

prior_candidate.usage: Frozen feature-derived baseline on official IDs. Do not fit or calibrate this adjustment to the baseline values. For 415 template-only eastern-WA rows, use approved formatting fill 0.0, not C2's historical pooled-mean fill.

candidate_adjustment.adjustment_direction: nonnegative feature-only conservative sensitivity; sparse contextual density increases the estimate by at most 0.05
candidate_adjustment.context_support: mean of the available four neighborhood support summaries (population and Overture building density at 5 km and 20 km); if none available, 1.0

density_features.tract_overture_building_density: overture_buildings / (ALAND / 1,000,000) records per square kilometer, defined only for positive finite ALAND
density_features.tract_population_density: pop_total / (ALAND / 1,000,000) persons per square kilometer, defined only for positive finite ALAND

acs_geometry.crs: EPSG:4326 input, transformed to EPSG:5070 before centroid distances
acs_geometry.meaning: Provided tract boundary geometry only; housing_units and all other columns are not read

acs_strata.meaning: Provided tract land area and population for density; urban/rural class is used only for descriptive grouping

overture.meaning: Provided Overture building record counts assigned to official tract polygons

template_ids.meaning: Score-free, previously committed projection of the platform template; no template score placeholders are read

measurement_plan.after: Report 5 km/20 km neighbor counts and support summaries, missingness, four-region and urbanity delta distributions, candidate bounds/IDs/hashes, and leave-one-tract-out self-invariance checks.
measurement_plan.before: Freeze C2 full-artifact hash; report official-scope global, four-region, and urbanity-class score moments and coverage of existing provided density inputs before adjustment.

neighborhood.aggregation: arithmetic mean of the available neighboring tract population-support values and Overture-building-support values, separately at each radius
neighborhood.empty_context: each unavailable radius/metric summary is explicitly missing and filled with neutral 0.5 in the candidate table; final context support averages only available summaries; if all four summaries are missing, use context support 1.0 and zero adjustment (no evidence, no change)
neighborhood.location: centroid of provided official tract geometry
neighborhood.region_boundary_safety: build and query a separate spatial index per official challenge region; only the 9,379 official tract GEOIDs in that same region may be neighbors; never cross region boundaries or add the seven extra Texas ACS polygons
neighborhood.self_exclusion: exclude the focal tract GEOID from every neighborhood before aggregation (leave-one-tract-out); no own-tract density enters its context feature

prior_candidate.usage: Frozen feature-derived baseline on official IDs. Do not fit or calibrate this adjustment to the baseline values. For 415 template-only eastern-WA rows, use approved formatting fill 0.0, not C2's historical pooled-mean fill.

method.purpose: analysis-only fixed density-context sensitivity using provided challenge Overture counts, ACS tract geometry, and strata; no target fitting, target-RMSE claim, or upload
